title: Règlement COSOB n° 25-04 du 22 octobre 2025 relatif à la divulgation de l'information à publier par les sociétés dont les valeurs sont cotées à la bourse des valeurs mobilières (Art. 44-45: annual extra-financial ESG report), with the Finance Ministry arrêté of 29 novembre 2025 approving it
citation: Arrêté du 8 Joumada Ethania 1447 (29 novembre 2025) portant approbation du règlement COSOB n° 25-04 du 30 Rabie Ethani 1447 (22 octobre 2025), JORADP n° 12 of 2026-02-10, p. 31 ff.
evidence: Arrêté Art. 2: "Le présent arrêté sera publié au Journal officiel de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire." The règlement (Art. 1 to 54, Art. 54 repeals COSOB règlement n° 2000-02) has no entry-into-force clause. JO n° 12 is dated 22 Chaâbane 1447 / 10 février 2026 (page header, opened https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2026/F2026012.pdf on 2026-11-03).
notes: Record text is the approving arrêté and the whole règlement as printed in JO n° 12 (Arabic and French editions). Art. 44: every issuer on the main compartment of the equity market "doit publier annuellement un rapport sur l'information extra-financière couvrant les aspects environnementaux, sociaux et de gouvernance (ESG)", model set by a COSOB instruction (not found), optional independent verification; Art. 45: published with the annual information and on the issuer's website. The first ESG report "for financial year 2027" reported in the press is not in the gazette text (no 2027 and no commencement clause in it); the gazette's title says "bourse des valeurs mobilières" where the register row's earlier title said ESG. Second URL for the same règlement, not used as a source: https://cosob.dz/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/REGL-25-04.pdf (COSOB PDF, 200, 59072 bytes, French). Statute point: a COSOB règlement is a regulation of an independent authority; Ordonnance 03-05 Art. 11 covers "règlements ... des organes de l'Etat", and the stored text is the gazette text issued by the Secrétariat général du Gouvernement. The COSOB site was not used and has no row. No commencement clause: the in_force date is the date of the JO issue that published the text, used under the lookup policy; the day after publication (Civil Code art. 4) was not read and is not applied. No government English text: looked for on joradp.dz, which serves the Arabic and French editions only; none found.

title: Loi n° 03-10 du 19 juillet 2003 relative à la protection de l'environnement dans le cadre du développement durable
citation: Loi n° 03-10 du 19 Joumada El Oula 1424 (19 juillet 2003), JORADP n° 43 of 2003-07-20
evidence: Art. 114: "La présente loi sera publiée au Journal officiel de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire." Art. 113 repeals Loi n° 83-03 of 5 February 1983. JO n° 43 is dated 20 Joumada El Oula 1424 / 20 juillet 2003 (opened https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2003/F2003043.pdf on 2026-11-03).
notes: Framework environmental law (114 articles). Text is the law as adopted; later amending laws were not read and no consolidated text is served by joradp.dz, so the record is not the text in force today. The four-line Arabic oath in Art. 101 is not stored (legacy font, replaced in the record by one bracketed line). No commencement clause: the in_force date is the date of the JO issue that published the text, used under the lookup policy; the day after publication (Civil Code art. 4) was not read and is not applied. Arabic edition of the same issue (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/JO-ARABE/2003/A2003043.pdf) is the authentic text but its PDF uses a legacy font that does not extract in reading order, so no Arabic record is stored. No government English text: looked for on joradp.dz, which serves the Arabic and French editions only; none found.

title: Loi n° 04-02 du 23 juin 2004 fixant les règles applicables aux pratiques commerciales (Art. 28: publicité illicite)
citation: Loi n° 04-02 du 5 Joumada El Oula 1425 (23 juin 2004), JORADP n° 41 of 2004-06-27
evidence: Art. 67: "La présente loi sera publiée au Journal officiel de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire." JO n° 41 is dated 9 Joumada El Oula 1425 / 27 juin 2004 (opened https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2004/F2004041.pdf on 2026-11-03).
notes: Art. 28: "est considérée comme publicité illicite et interdite toute publicité trompeuse", including advertising that may mislead on the characteristics of a product or service. The law has no environmental-claims provision; it is the umbrella for misleading advertising. Text is the law as adopted; later amendments were not read. No commencement clause: the in_force date is the date of the JO issue that published the text, used under the lookup policy; the day after publication (Civil Code art. 4) was not read and is not applied. Arabic edition of the same issue (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/JO-ARABE/2004/A2004041.pdf) is the authentic text but its PDF uses a legacy font that does not extract in reading order, so no Arabic record is stored. title: Loi n° 91-25 du 18 décembre 1991 portant loi de finances pour 1992 (Art. 117: taxe sur les activités polluantes ou dangereuses pour l'environnement, as later amended)
citation: Loi n° 91-25 du 18 décembre 1991 portant loi de finances pour 1992, JORADP n° 65 of 1991-12-18, p. 1998
evidence: No official page opened states an in-force date. The cover of JO n° 65 (Mercredi 18 décembre 1991, French edition, read as an image) lists "Loi n° 91-25 du 18 décembre 1991 portant loi de finances pour 1992, p. 1998". The PDF has no text layer, so Art. 117 and any commencement clause were not read.
notes: Link only. The link between this law and the pollution tax rests on a web-search snippet quoting Décret exécutif n° 93-68 ("l'article 117 de la loi n° 91-25 du 18 décembre 1991 portant loi de finances pour 1992"), not on an official page read. JO n° 65 of 1991 is a scan (French 78 pages and Arabic 99 pages, pdftotext returns no characters) and there is no OCR in this environment. The tax was amended by later finance laws (a search result names LF 2001 Art. 202 and LF 2020) and Décret exécutif n° 09-336 of 20 October 2009 sets the activities and coefficients (an index lists it as repealed); none of these was opened. No ETS or per-tonne carbon price was found: no instrument of that kind appears in the JO issues opened or in the search results, so none is listed. The CO2-based vehicle taxes in the finance laws were not looked for in the JO.
status_note: JO n° 65 of 1991 is a scanned image PDF with no text layer; no text can be stored.
